why: What the PRODUCT makes in the machine's temp directory under the coai- prefix, written down so that nothing which cleans up after a test run ever takes it.
No test sweep deletes by this file. The age-only coai- test sweep (the extension's sweepTemp.mjs and the server suite's PanelService.PruneOldScratchDirs call in
TempDirsAreSwept) was retired by E5 S2-A of todo/PLAN_test_leftovers_E5.md, 2026-11-02: both runners now COUNT the old coai-* directories at their start,
name the number, and leave them (src_vs_code/scripts/startOfRun.mjs, src_mcp/tests/StartOfRun.cs). The one-off clean-up scripts/old-coai-leftovers.mjs is a
person's tool, never a sweep, and it refuses every prefix in this list.
neverSwept is what the PRODUCT makes at runtime under the same prefix: a round's answers, its repair launch, a workspace-less review, an escalation's plan, a Team
server job, a question row's scratch, a chat's working directory, and a consultant check's scratch repository (coai-check-, which the product removes after a day).
A live chat can sit for an hour writing nothing, so its directory is older than any window a sweep could use; the product sweeps these itself, on its own clock
(PanelService.PruneOldScratchDirs). A downloaded server, coai-<version>, is a cache and is never scratch either. The list is held complete by three scans that
read only this key: TempDirsAreSwept (the server), startOfRun.test.mjs (the extension) and TheTestSweepLeavesAJobAloneTests (the Team server), each over its own
What a test run makes lives inside its own testsToDelete-coai-run-<6> folder, which the run removes itself; the history of the retired sweep is
research/PLAN_the_tests_take_their_temp_directories_with_them.md (the sweep it describes was retired by E5 S2-A).
